decisions.statement: The collectible catalog arrives as an argument rather than as an imported table.
A heading and the categories beneath the heading arrive together in one flat list.
A category naming no parent is a heading.
A category whose parent names no category in the list is a heading too.
A heading carrying collectibles directly gives a subheading named as the heading is.
A category stating no display order sorts at zero.
Categories sharing a display order keep the order of arrival.
No collectible category landed today states a display order.
A heading stating no category index is reckoned at index zero.
An empty catalog answers an empty progress.

definition: how many collectibles an account has unlocked, category by category
